about: Quarantined: abilities and site mechanisms that only legacy campaigns and recorded histories use. New modules declare mechanisms as Hazards in their own module. Lint rejects these in recommended campaigns.

dawn_spark.name: Dawn spark
dawn_spark.effect: Deal (max(0, 1d6 + statMod(#wisdom))) radiant damage to enemy.

cinder_lesson.name: Cinder lesson
cinder_lesson.effect: Teach cinder to self. Grant 40 experience to self.

censer_counterweight.name: Falling counterweight
censer_counterweight.effect: Deal (1d6) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (11). Apply bleeding to ally for 2 turns unless dexterity save against (11).

censer_miasma.name: Ossuary spore cloud
censer_miasma.effect: Deal (1d4) poison damage to ally unless constitution save against (11). Apply poisoned to ally for 3 turns unless constitution save against (11).

censer_shutters.name: Burial shutters
censer_shutters.effect: Deal (1d4) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (12). Apply weakened to ally for 2 turns unless constitution save against (12).

brace_line.name: Brace the line
brace_line.effect: Apply warded to party for 2 turns.

orsino_flame_blade.name: Strike with the Longsword of Flames
